fit_reason: Whole passenger car (2004 Camry sedan) listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Gold paint on the passenger side looks flat and lacks gloss, with dust visible on the doors and lower panels
Dirt and stains on the front passenger and driver floor mats
Light soiling and smudges on the cloth front seat bottoms and rear bench
Dirt and scuffs on the door sills and kick plates at the front and rear door openings
Spots on the windshield seen from the driver door
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2004 Camry. The interior looks solid, but the floor mats and door sills are showing dirt, and the gold paint looks a bit flat in the photos. We do mobile pre-sale details, including interior shampoo and a wash, polish and wax, and we can come to you. Would you like a quote?
